item.title: Exploring Audio Experiences
item.description:
Hi there! My name is Jakob and I am a technical sound and interaction designer. I am passionate about creating engaging interactive audio experiences, as well as the tools and systems that drive them!

Check out my reel and portfolio section above, or head to the scripts & audio tools page to see and download some of the tools I’ve build. Go to the about page if you are interested in learning more about my journey with audio, up to now.
